meta.notice: Prototype, synthetic data. Scores show how the pipeline behaves, not conditions at real places.
meta.disclaimer: The score estimates potential customer exposure plus context, including hazard exposure. It does not predict sales or business survival. Hazard values are indicative, not a survey.
meta.range_method: 10th-90th percentile of actual/predicted site-mean ratios in the block-grouped spatial holdout, applied to P̄
meta.components_note: No per-component contribution points: a geometric mean has no additive breakdown.
